definitions.gloss: end of the mourning period; lifting of mourning
definitions.explanation: The day or time when the formal mourning period concludes, traditionally 49 days after a death in Buddhism (四十九日). After this point, one can resume normal social and celebratory activities.

examples.english: The mourning period comes to an end.

examples.japanese: {四十九日|しじゅうくにち}を{迎|むか}えて{忌明|きあ}けとなった。
examples.english: The 49th day arrived and the mourning period ended.

examples.japanese: {忌明|きあ}けの{法要|ほうよう}を{親戚|しんせき}が{集|あつ}まって{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: Family members gathered to hold a memorial service marking the end of the mourning period.

notes:
The mourning period ends after 49 days ({四十九日|しじゅうくにち}) in Buddhist tradition. On this day a memorial service is typically held.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忌明|きあ}けを{迎|むか}える: the mourning period ends
- {忌明|きあ}けの{法要|ほうよう}: memorial service at the end of mourning
- {忌明|きあ}けとなる: to become the end of the mourning period

RELATED WORDS:
- {喪中|もちゅう}: in the mourning period
- {四十九日|しじゅうくにち}: 49th day memorial
- {法要|ほうよう}: Buddhist memorial service
